title: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset 25.1: every organised-violence event located in Lebanon, 1989-2024
source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), GED Global version 25.1
citation: Davies, Shawn, Therese Pettersson and Magnus Oberg (2025). Organized violence 1989-2024. Journal of Peace Research. Sundberg and Melander (2013), Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset, Journal of Peace Research 50(4).
notes: Only events located in Lebanon (UCDP country = Lebanon). Attacks launched from Lebanon that hit places in Israel are located in Israel, so they are not here. GED holds every event of a UCDP dyad or actor that crossed the 25 battle-related-deaths threshold in at least one year; a year with no row (here 2004, 2007, 2009-2010, 2019, 2021-2022) means UCDP codes no qualifying event, not that nothing happened. GED 25.1 ends 2024. Event counts are not comparable across years as a measure of intensity: use best/low/high deaths. date_prec 1 = exact day, 2 = within 2-6 days, 3 = week, 4 = 8-30 days or a month, 5 = longer than a month, under a year (date_start and date_end then bound the event). where_prec 1 = exact location, 2 = within about 25 km of the coded point, 3 = second-order admin centroid, 4 = first-order admin centroid, 5 = linear feature or fuzzy region, 6 = country only, 7 = international waters or airspace. type: 1 state-based, 2 non-state, 3 one-sided violence. adm_1 indexes the adm1 list; side_a and side_b index the sides list. id and relid are UCDP event identifiers (the source id). best, low and high are UCDP estimates of total deaths in the event.
